    def negatives(self, u, positions, requested):
        # DEBUG: No traceback was supplied; this fixes a static memory hazard.
        # Sample ranks in the eligible catalog, then map ranks to actual IDs.
        # This preserves uniform sampling without replacement and excludes all
        # training positives without allocating or caching catalog-sized arrays.
        if positions < 0 or requested < 0:
            raise ValueError("Position and negative counts must be nonnegative")
        seen = self.seen[u]  # Sorted, unique, nonpadding training item IDs.
        if np.any((seen < 1) | (seen > self.itemnum)):
            raise ValueError("Training history contains out-of-vocabulary item IDs")
        available = self.itemnum - len(seen)
        k = min(requested, available)
        result = np.empty((positions, k), dtype=np.int64)
        if positions == 0 or k == 0:
            return result

        # For one-based eligible rank r, each excluded ID s_i contributes a
        # skipped slot exactly when s_i - i <= r (i is zero-based).
        # Repeated offsets are intentional for consecutive excluded IDs.
        excluded_offsets = seen - np.arange(len(seen), dtype=np.int64)
        for row in range(positions):
            ranks = self.rng.choice(available, size=k, replace=False) + 1
            result[row] = ranks + np.searchsorted(
                excluded_offsets, ranks, side="right"
            )
        return result
